text:
ava_pm: Quick async sync — we're landing the new packaging-based pricing changes next sprint. I want a short status from each owning team + any blockers that need product/legal escalation. TL;DR: metering tag changes, quota enforcement hook, billing schema update, contract edge-cases for enterprise customers.

diego_eng: working on the quota enforcement hook. PR open: https://git.internal/r/redwood/quotas/pull/421. Needs review from riley_platform and a small runtime change to expose `quota_bucket_id` in request headers. Estimated merge: EOD Thu.

riley_platform: I'll review today. FYI runtime change adds 1 field to the request proto + compatibility layer. Back-compat plan: if header absent, default to tenant-level bucket. No db migration required.

sam_billing: Billing schema change: we need a new `packaging_tier` enum and the per-call unit rate. I drafted migration script and a dry-run query — will post in a sec. Important: enterprise legacy contracts with custom SKUs need to map to the new enum or we risk incorrect invoicing.

ava_pm: @sam_billing — can you confirm if the mapping table exists for legacy SKUs or do we need legal to sign off on mappings?

maya_legal: We have a mapping doc for ~85% of customers, but a handful (3) have addenda with usage terms that don't cleanly map. We need to surface those to sales and confirm how to bill during the transition window. Recommend a temporary manual override flag.

sam_billing: Ack. I'll add a `manual_billing_override` boolean to the migration plan and an ops dashboard filter for those accounts. Also adding alerts if post-migration invoice deltas > 10%.

diego_eng: Blocker: our metering client library (used by Dedicated/private) needs to emit the new tag `packaging_tier` on the token generation path. That's in `client-js` and `client-go`. Riley — does platform plan a coordinated release with runtime?

riley_platform: Yes — we should cut a platform release that vendors can consume. Plan: platform RC on Mon, final Wed. We need docs + code samples for private customers. Also: we'll toggle a runtime feature flag to avoid impacting older clients.

ava_pm: Milestone check: want to freeze public API surface by next Wednesday so docs/console teams can prep UI. Can each owner confirm if that date works?

diego_eng: Works assuming PR reviews finish by Thu and we cut RC Mon.

sam_billing: Works for billing schema migration dry-run, but production migration scheduled for Fri of the following week to give time for manual mappings.

maya_legal: Works — I'll coordinate with Sales for the 3 edge customers and get written approvals.

riley_platform: Docs + example snippets on Monday. Will need a tiny doc review from developer experience — @ava_pm can you loop them in?

ava_pm: Done — added devex to the tracker. One more thing: QA found a corner case where quota enforcement and caching interact and could double-count a burst if the cache TTL is too short. Diego, can you add a test?

diego_eng: Yep — adding an e2e that simulates burst + cache eviction. Will include test in PR.

infra-bot: deploybot: New CI pipeline job added: `billing-migration-dryrun`. Status: queued.

ava_pm: Great. Action items summary: diego -> merge PR + add e2e; riley -> platform RC + docs; sam -> migration script + override UI + alerts; maya -> get 3 contract sign-offs; ava -> coordinate devex + console. If anyone expects delays, call it out here by EOD. Otherwise we'll treat this as the plan. :white_check_mark:

riley_platform: Noted. If needed we can carve a canary region for the first 48h after migration.

sam_billing: Will prepare the canary invoice run for one account group.

ava_pm: Thanks team — ping me if anything changes.
